name: BeoRadioScrobbler
description: Scrobbles Tracks played on a Bang & Olufsen Speaker supporting BeoNetRemote Client API via radio.

paths.name: appdata
paths.description: The folder on your system that will contain 'logs' and 'config' folders. Most likely: appdata/beoradioscrobbler

variables.name: LASTFM_API_KEY
variables.description: The API key generated on LAST.FM

variables.name: LASTFM_API_SECRET
variables.description: The API secret generated on LAST.FM

variables.name: LASTFM_PASSWORD
variables.description: Your LAST.FM password. Only stored as an environment variable. Not exposed, getting hashed from library pylast.

variables.name: LOCAL_TIMEZONE
variables.description: Time zone like 'Europe/Berlin' - will be defaulted to UTC if empty.

variables.name: RUN_MODE
variables.description: See documentation page. Possible values: ['production', 'detect', 'notify_me']. Will default to 'detect' if empty.

variables.name: BEO_IP
variables.description: IP address of the B&O device, in the format '192.168.1.1'.

variables.name: LOGLEVEL
variables.description: Log level in general log file. INFO, DEBUG. Defaults to INFO.
